outcome: Incidence of post dural puncture headache (PDPH)
cohort: The study included 200 parturients aged 18-45 years of ASA grade II who underwent elective or emergency caesarean section.
finding: The incidence of PDPH was 1% with intrathecal fentanyl and 4% with the control group, with the fentanyl group experiencing milder PDPH, although the decrease in incidence and severity was non-significant.
